title: Estar for how someone feels
explanation: Use estoy to say how you feel, estás to ask one person, and está to speak about another person. Keep this bounded to simple health or condition phrases.

title: Estoy for condition, está for location
explanation: Estoy describes the speaker condition. Está can locate a known place or person. Do not use soy for temporary health condition.

title: Tener for fever
explanation: Use tengo fiebre for I have a fever. Use tienes fiebre to ask one person. This is a fixed beginner health pattern, not a full medical explanation.

title: Me duele for basic pain
explanation: Use me duele plus one controlled body word to say where something hurts. Treat it as a fixed useful pattern at A0.

title: Basic health questions
explanation: Use short questions to check what is wrong. This module uses tú questions such as ¿Qué te pasa? and ¿Tienes fiebre?

title: Health service requests
explanation: Use necesito with one clear health service or help word. The app teaches language for requesting help, not medical advice.

title: Bounded health help exchange
explanation: A simple health exchange can combine attention, condition, symptom, service request, location and communication repair. Keep the sequence short and authored.
examples: Disculpe. No estoy bien. Necesito una farmacia.
¿Qué te pasa? Me duele la cabeza.
